technical.summary: Mixed technicals with short-term bullish structure (supertrend, hull, psar) conflicting with bearish momentum (negative MACD, CMF, below key MAs), overbought stochRSI, and price below VWAP—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 72 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite bipartisan congressional selling 92-104 days ago; no recent news data to confirm sentiment.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (396.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event 72 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend/Hull/PSAR bullish structure with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) offers contrarian entry near support (54.48) if macro stabilizes.
